result.meaning: No definite new application P1 was established in the assigned policy/native-session/recovery scope. The needs_more_work flag primarily identifies explicitly unexercised matrices; it is not itself a demonstrated source defect or a mechanical deployment veto. Final package/operational/field acceptance remains Root's separate responsibility. establishedBySource: Explicit new_session preserves the original owner command, stopped source/result hash and old task session, and saves pendingNativeHandoff with the current policyId/generation. It requires an active goal policy rather than silently creating one.

Dispatch receipt binds the pending handoff to its actual new run. reconcileNativeHandoff accepts only that current run's non-late signed result, same task current request/session and fixed project/machine/workspace, matching nativeLineage and original signed stop result hash/proof.

rebindNative compares active policyId/generation and previous native session, requires a distinct nonempty next session, preserves the goal authorization/caps/generation and records the verified handoff reason in immutable policy history. It does not generally migrate arbitrary old authorization.

The reconciliation is reached before ordinary advance and from allows, so a just-returned new native session can satisfy subsequent dispatch/claim policy checks. A revoked or replaced generation cannot rebind.

A crash after storing the policy but before clearing the pending supervisor field is source-idempotent: rebindNative returns the already matching policy, then the pending field is cleared/saved. This is static reasoning, not a newly run crash test.
nativePolicyFix.savedMechanismEvidence: The final paired stop test now goes beyond the first new child: after signed long-child cancellation and explicit owner handoff, the new child starts without --resume and a third actual finite child resumes exactly the new native session. It asserts current task session and a verified-native-handoff policy-history reason. The saved final-affected log reports this case passing. Pi/native-format output is an explicit deterministic fixture; real supplier/101 CC field use is not established.

boundaryEvidence.knownOver10M: A real finite native-format child reports 10,000,001 signed tokens through createApp/DTO/SQLite/TCP paired agent. The same preserved history opens a policy window capped at 1000 for the successor. The test executes the second actual child, verifies its result and at least two journal ACKs, and verifies the original 10,000,001 remains unchanged. Finite reporting deliberately crosses a technical token boundary; it is not a real model spending experiment.
boundaryEvidence.queuedPause: After a real supervisor request is queued, owner pause cancels it and revokes the policy. The paired agent runOnce returns null and the child marker file is absent. This is a real claim/no-child branch, not an execution stub.

The only agent-runner delta is the r6 build label. Runtime/agent/archive labels are reported consistently as 20261017-cc-supervisor-r43-r6. confirmedRootControlFinding.priority: P1 for use of this maintenance control against a successfully rebound R9 history
confirmedRootControlFinding.proof: R9 rebindNative stores a changed nativeSessionId under the same policyId/generation with reason verified-native-handoff:<child>:<source>:<hash>. r4:183 requires every duplicate (policyId,generation) history policy object to be completely equal, so the first valid rebind unconditionally raises R43_NUP_POLICY_HISTORY_REQUIRED. Merely choosing the last history row would also make owner_lineage_proof incorrectly treat the new native session as the old source session for the pre-handoff window.
confirmedRootControlFinding.narrowCorrection: A distinct Root-authored control must recognize only the exact verified-native-handoff history transition, keep all non-native authorization fields and generation identical, verify the stopped source/owner command/window/accepted signed new result chain, and retain the correct pre-transition snapshot for the owner-lineage window. Do not blindly relax all same-generation history equality or disguise application revocation. Preserve every existing activity/intent/projection/usage guard and phase/pin behavior.
confirmedRootControlFinding.schemaDelta: R9 adds supervisor_projection_stages and supervisor_notice_outbox; existing supervisor, execution and goal-policy table fields read by r4 remain. The new projection staging is behind the existing unfinished supervisor_projection gate; this review found no definite new source mismatch in the existing field names/statuses/sourceHash extraction. New notification work is not execution/lease activity. The specific policy-history semantic change above is the determined blocker.
